newsitem.title: FINLAND: NORDIC ALUMINIUM PLANS IPO, HELSINKI LISTING.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC ALUMINIUM PLANS IPO, HELSINKI LISTING.

text.p: Finnish aluminium components maker Nordic Aluminium said in a statement on Monday it planned an initial public offering in which its owners would sell a majority stake, and a subsequent listing.
"The share offering will start on April 9, when the price range will be announced, and end on April 17," it said.
"The shares sold in the offering will be offered to both international and Finnish institutional investors as well as to the general public in Finland," Nordic Aluminium said.
Some of its shareholders and affiliates including Morgan Stanley Capital Partners, plus managed by CapMan Capital Management Oy intended to sell a majority of their shares in the offering, it said.
Nordic Aluminium will also offer a limited number of new shares to its employees and non-executive directors, it said.
The offer would be lead managed by Enskilda Securities, with Postipankki as co-lead handling share sales to Finnish retail investors, it said.
Trade was expected to start on or about April 24.

The company manufactures aluminium products for the electrotechnical, mechanical engineering, transport equipment, construction, telecommunications and other industries, it said, but gave no financial details.
